## Tidepool — Landing Page Build Plan

**Global system:** Cream paper background (#FAF5EC), deep forest green (#173B2E) for ink and dark panels, coral (#FF6B52) for accents and CTAs. Warm serif display (Fraunces) for headlines, clean grotesk for body, monospace for small labels — the mono carries the "week nodes" motif throughout.

**1. Hero.** Left rail: vertical Mon–Fri timeline, each day a node with a mono label and a small coral dot indicating "load." Right two-thirds: serif headline as one long breath — *"Bring your whole team around one living view of the week that updates the moment plans change, remembers what everyone is actually carrying, and quietly clears the fog before Monday's standup so nobody has to ask 'wait, what are we doing this week?' again."* A hand-drawn coral arrow curls from the headline to a screenshot of the week board. One coral button: "Plan your first week."

**2. Proof strip.** Slim cream row, six low-contrast forest wordmarks of small studios. Mono caption only: "used by small teams at."

**3. The board.** Sticky product mock left; three features right — "See the whole week" (shared Mon–Fri board), "Change once, everyone sees" (live sync), "Spot overload early" (capacity dots). Serif subhead, two body lines, mono tag each.

**4. Pull quote.** Full-width forest panel, oversized coral quotation mark, quote in mono cream: *"We cancelled our Monday meeting. Tidepool is the meeting now."* Name + role beneath.

**5. The ritual.** Three steps strung on mini day-nodes: Monday plan (15 minutes), midweek drift handled quietly, Friday look-back. Small line-art vignettes in forest ink.

**6. Final CTA.** Centered serif line — *"Next Monday could feel different."* — coral button beside an email field.

**7. Footer.** Forest background; the seven-node week timeline repeated as a decorative rule; mono nav links.

## Tidepool — Revised Landing Page Plan

**Global system:** Same palette (cream #FAF5EC, forest #173B2E, coral #FF6B52) plus a pale sage tint for panels. Fraunces display serif, grotesk body, mono labels. Two recurring motifs: the day-node timeline and hand-drawn coral annotations — now used twice, deliberately.

**1. Hero.** Left rail: Mon–Fri timeline where nodes carry tiny avatars and coral load-bars — it previews the product, not just decorates. Headline rewritten natively instead of templated: *"Your team's whole week in one shared place — planned together Monday in fifteen minutes, updated the moment anything shifts, and wrapped up Friday so nothing slips away quietly."* Hand-drawn coral arrow to the week-board screenshot, captioned in handwriting: *"live — Sam just moved something."*

**2. Live ticker (replaces wordmark strip — fake logos broke the honest, hand-made feel).** A slim mono ticker cycling real-feeling events: *"maya moved 'launch review' → Thu · 2m ago."* Proof of instant sync before a single scroll.

**3. The board.** Sticky mock left; three jobs-to-be-done right: **One board, whole week** (no channel-diving), **Changes travel instantly** (live cursors, no refresh), **Overload shows itself** (capacity dots turn coral before someone's Thursday quietly breaks). Mono tag per feature.

**4. Pull quote.** Full-width forest panel, coral mark, mono cream: *"We killed our Monday status meeting. Tidepool is the status."*

**5. The ritual.** Three steps strung on day-nodes: Monday plan (15 min), midweek drift absorbed silently, Friday look-back that writes itself. Second hand-drawn arrow points at Friday: *"this is where the meeting used to be."*

**6. Final CTA.** Centered serif: *"Next Monday, fifteen minutes. That's the whole ritual."* Email field + coral button, "Start your week."

**7. Footer.** Forest, seven-node timeline as a decorative rule, mono nav.

**Key upgrades:** native copy, proof-of-sync replacing logos, annotation system extended, concrete UI specifics throughout.
